channel.title: Animation Gems
channel.description: Animation watch — open source software, Blender animation add-ons, rigging, mocap and video capture, 2D animation (Grease Pencil, OpenToonz, Krita…).

item.title: Face Shape Key Rig 1.0.234 (shape key controllers, iPhone mocap and lip-sync)
item.description: Face add-on: in-viewport sliders and 2D pads to drive your shape keys (plain bones + drivers), iFacialMocap face capture, automatic lip-sync from a voice track, and a 2D sprite-face mode on 3D characters. 1.0.234 published Nov 3 on Extensions. GPL-3.0.

item.title: OZO Tools 0.10.6 (Tweak/FK, IK/FK arms and MCH sockets in a few clicks)
item.description: First public release (Nov 9) of a Blender rigging toolkit: Tweak/FK controls from a bone chain, arms with IK/FK switch and pole, MCH sockets, rotation follow, prefix-based Copy Transforms and animation scaling. Blender 5.2+, GPL-3.0, docs mostly in Chinese.

item.title: zh-lipsync 0.1.0 (phonetic lip-sync for Mandarin)
item.description: Released Nov 10: turns a Mandarin voice track (plus subtitles if you have them) into a JSON timeline of a/i/u/e/o/n mouth shapes matched to each syllable, not to volume. Runs locally via faster-whisper, exports Rhubarb format. MIT, built for 2D avatars.

item.title: BVH Motion Retargeter 5.0.0 (mocap cleanup: contacts and arms)
item.description: Released Nov 9, already seen Nov 4 as 4.0: V5 turns into a mocap cleanup bench inside Blender. Mark heel, toe or palm contacts, the add-on corrects root and chains over time and repairs broken arm spins (up to 3 s). MIT.

item.title: RigSwitch (one-click outfit or prop switch on any rig)
item.description: Published Nov 8: RigSwitch builds, in one click, a slider that swaps outfits and props on your rig using native drivers, so the rig works for anyone without the add-on. Blender 4.2 to 5.2. Free Lite edition, full version $12 on BlendKit.

item.title: Loop Noise 1.0.0 (F-curve noise that loops seamlessly)
item.description: Published Nov 1: the same noise as Blender’s Noise modifier, but cyclic over a frame range you pick, with no jump in position or speed at the seam. Ideal for looping idles, breathing and camera shake. GPL-3.0.

item.title: Faster Scrubbing 1.6.2 (smooth scrubbing on heavy mocap)
item.description: Updated Nov 5: automatically hides keyframes in the Dope Sheet and Graph Editor during playback or scrubbing, so the timeline stops lagging on mocap files with thousands of frames. 1.6.2 detects scrubbing through frame handlers. GPL-3.0.

item.title: Webcam Avatar Studio 1.2.0 (webcam mocap down to the fingers, BVH export)
item.description: Released Nov 7: a plain webcam captures face, body, hands and every finger, drives VSeeFace/Warudo over VMC and exports BVH for Blender. 1.2.0 shows your VRM in OBS without a VTuber app. MIT code, but non-commercial models.

item.title: reanimate-motion (video → BVH on any character)
item.description: Published Nov 7 (MIT): this command-line kit tracks the body frame by frame in a video, cleans and solves it into a BVH with Mixamo bone names, then keys your Blender rig or a three.js character. Runs locally, with checks proving each rule.

item.title: RuiC-2D (one illustration → rigged, lip-synced 2D avatar)
item.description: Published Nov 6 (MIT): from a single front-facing illustration, this local editor splits the parts, adds a deformable mesh, syncs the mouth to your voice, animates blinks and tail on a timeline and runs from your webcam (MediaPipe) into OBS.

item.title: LivLiv Player 0.3.0 (2.5D web character with lip sync)
item.description: Open-sourced Nov 5 (Apache-2.0), on npm since 0.3.0 on Nov 6: a ~30 KB WebGL2 player that makes a 2.5D character talk (lip sync from mic, audio or video), follows your face via webcam and also plays VRM and PNGTuber. 21 characters, own licences.

item.title: Annex Labeler 1.0 (C3D mocap marker labeling on Mac)
item.description: Released Nov 6 on the Mac App Store: opens C3D files from any mocap system, labels markers by click, fills gaps with splines and re-exports C3D, for free. The Pro subscription adds model-based auto-labeling (reads .vsk) and rigid-body gap filling.

item.title: Tr_overlap (overlap and follow-through baked to keys, Blender and Maya)
item.description: Spotted Nov 7: select your controls or bones, click, and Tr_overlap bakes overlap, spring or cloth-like motion for hair and clothes into keys, with colliders, wind and loop mode, leaving your action intact. Free edition, Pro at $11.99.

item.title: BlenderBiped 0.8.9 (Rigify Biped-style controls)
item.description: Released Nov 5 (GPL-2.0+, Blender 5.2+ Rigify): a Biped feature set — FK when you rotate the upper arm/thigh, IK when you move the hand/foot, auto sync, Planted/Sliding keys, FBX import for Mixamo/Biped/Humanoid.

item.title: Moveset 1.3.8 (animation library for any humanoid rig)
item.description: Updated Nov 6 (GPL, Blender 4.2–5.2): 893 retargetable clips for Rigify/Mixamo/UE/VRoid — Miner and sword-and-shield kits, 13 manner packs, freemium (55 free clips on itch, full pack ~$30).

item.title: OpenAnimEasy 0.2.0 (free AnimEasy alternative)
item.description: Released Nov 6 (GPL-3.0, Blender 4.4+/5.2): a free AnimEasy alternative — 36+ timing/curve/spacing/posing operators, JSON pose library, and in 0.2.0 editable motion paths in the 3D View.

item.title: Kimodo Motion Importer 1.0.0 (Kimodo NPZ → your rig)
item.description: Released Nov 4 (Apache-2.0): imports Kimodo motions (.npz, SOMA/SMPL-X/G1) and retargets them onto your Mixamo, Rigify, UE or VRM rig — auto bone map, scaled root motion, a ready-to-edit Blender action.

item.title: Rigby2D 0.5.0 (Defold, sprite sheets, auto mesh)
item.description: First covered Oct 15; Nov 6 ships 0.5.0 (MIT): native C++ Defold runtime (frame-perfect), sprite-sheet/atlas export, one-click mesh from image alpha, Godot out of preview, Win/Mac/Linux installers.

item.title: Editable Motion Paths 2.0.0 (editable arcs in the 3D View)
item.description: Released Nov 5 (GPL-3.0, Blender 4.4+): motion paths become an editable mesh — keys, Bézier handles, sculpt, timing chart, dissolve for mocap cleanup. Location/rotation/scale/value, several bones, Global/Local/Camera space; every edit lands as ordinary F-Curves.

item.title: UniView 2.1.0 (asset & rig visualizer)
item.description: Released today (MIT, Python/PyQt6/ModernGL): a lightweight viewer to inspect an asset and its skeleton — interactive FK gimbal, wireframe overlay, live bbox, Blender-style orientation. Handy for rig review outside a DCC.

item.title: face-builder (photos → rigged GLB avatar, no generative AI)
item.description: Updated Nov 5 (Apache-2.0): 100% local pipeline (Blender + MPFB) that builds a MakeHuman body, projects your photo, dresses from CC0 and retargets walk/idle/type/sit into an animated .glb. No generative AI; author quotes ~6/10 likeness.

item.title: Hand & Body Rigs 1.1.0 (pose-ready hand and Sentinel GLBs)
item.description: Published Nov 5: reusable GLB rig pack (L/R hands + Armored Sentinel V2) with JSON joint mappings and motion previews. MIT on the Sentinel; the hands/ package keeps its own license — check before commercial use.

item.title: Rig Bridge 0.4.1 (modular Blender control rigs)
item.description: Released Nov 4 (GPL-3.0, Blender 4.2+): Unreal-style Modular Control Rig add-on — detects Mixamo, UE5, Daz, CC/AccuRIG and 16 other standards, drops modules on sockets and compiles a control rig without changing the original bones.

item.title: Bulletproof Retarget 1.3.2
item.description: Released Nov 4 (Blender 5.0+, free zip): one-click retarget across P2M, Mixamo, Rigify, UE5, OptiTrack, ARP, Daz, VRM, CC and more — auto-detects up to 58 joints, Full/In Place root motion, FK/IK bake. Warning: no license file on the repo.

item.title: Video-to-3D-Mocap Studio (local multi-person mocap)
item.description: Published Nov 4 (MIT): local multi-person video→3D mocap studio (YOLO11-pose), fills in out-of-frame legs, exports FBX/BVH/blend with Mixamo white mannequins plus a Blender retarget script. Local web UI, CPU/CUDA/Apple Silicon.

item.title: CTRL_DEF 0.3.0 (Auto Rig Layers DEF/MCH/ORG/CTRL)
item.description: First covered Oct 25 as 0.1.2; Nov 2 ships 0.3.0 (GPL-3.0, Blender 4.2+): a real Auto Rig Layers DEF/MCH/ORG/CTRL pipeline with Rigify-style presets, cycle-safe chained generation, world +Y IK targets and optional poles.

item.title: rigfx 0.3.0 (2D pixel-art animation retarget)
item.description: Released Nov 5 (MIT): retargets a 2D pixel-art animation library onto bodies of any proportions (no GPU) — 12 moves × 17 characters, Aseprite JSON sprite-sheet export. Live demo on the site.

item.title: Weight Paint Box — Auto Weights (Nov 2 update)
item.description: Nov 2 update (paid ~$30, GPL, Blender 5.0–5.2): the box/cylinder weight-paint add-on adds Auto Weights (clothes, fingers, hair), Ebb & Flow to reshape a group without repainting, plus Draw Bone/Rigify mode.

item.title: BVH Motion Retargeter 4.0.0 (BVH, VMD → Mixamo, UE5, VRM)
item.description: Released Nov 4: this Blender 4.2+ add-on that retargets BVH mocap to Mixamo, UE5 or VRM rigs can now import, edit and re-export VMD (MMD) motion, denoise rotations and repair root motion. MIT, English and Chinese UI.

item.title: Yorishiro 0.1.5 (Live2D VTubing on Linux)
item.description: A Live2D VTubing app for Linux, launched Oct 31, with its own GPU face (52 ARKit expressions) and hand tracking via Vulkan and a transparent OBS output over PipeWire. 0.1.5 (Nov 4) self-updates. Free, public code but no license.

item.title: Ara 3D Gen (rigged, animated humans, self-hosted)
item.description: A human character generator built on MakeHuman (CC0) that runs in your browser or from the CLI: Mixamo-named auto-rig, 77 animations including mocap, lip-sync visemes, GLB/FBX export. Quick build mode added Nov 2. MIT, no account.

item.title: NK Auto IK 1.0.0 (one-click arm and leg IK)
item.description: Published Oct 29 on Blender Extensions: on a humanoid armature it detects arms and legs and sets up IK controls that bend knees and elbows the right way, no more reversed knees. GPL-3.0, Blender 4.5 LTS and up.

item.title: BBone to Bones 0.1.0 (bendy bones → real bone chains)
item.description: First release on Nov 2: the add-on converts your bendy bones into standard bone chains with weight transfer, action baking (Slotted Actions included) and Unity, Unreal and Godot export presets; you can revert to B-Bones. GPL-3.0.

item.title: MoCapGate 0.3.3 beta 9 (local video mocap)
item.description: Released Nov 3 (Windows): the app turns a video into an animated skeleton (GEM-X or GVHMR), with cleanup, foot contacts, BVH/Maya or FBX/GLB export via Blender, and adds calibrated multi-camera sessions. Apache-2.0 code; GVHMR/SMPL-X restrictive.

item.title: JustRigIt (auto-rig + local video mocap)
item.description: Published Nov 3: film a move on your phone, it captures it locally with NVIDIA’s GEM-X (fingers included), plants the feet, rigs your character if needed and exports for Unreal, Unity, Godot or Blender. AGPL-3.0; capture on Windows with an 8 GB+ RTX GPU.

item.title: HairDeck (stylized hair + spring bones from one image)
item.description: Code and weights released Oct 30: from a single image, HairDeck generates stylized hair cards and the spring-bone chains that animate them, skinning included, GLB or VRM export. Apache-2.0, Windows since Nov 2 and Mac since Nov 3.

item.title: StableGen 0.4.0 (SkinTokens auto-rig in Blender)
item.description: Released Oct 28: the StableGen Blender add-on adds “Auto-rig selected character”, skeleton + weights via SkinTokens locally (ComfyUI), then FBX/BVH animation retargeting onto the rig. GPL-3.0 code; some image models are non-commercial.

item.title: bonewright (Rigify auto-rig from a GLB)
item.description: Feed it a .glb, get back a skinned Rigify rig, with a gate that rejects bad meshes; humans, quadrupeds, BVH retargeting. MIT + GPL-3.0, Blender 5.2; joint placement via an LLM (~$1/rig) or a free mock mode. Commits up to Nov 2.

item.title: Humanoid Retargeter 1.2.0 (s&box)
item.description: Nov 1 release: this C# retargeter for the s&box editor (FBX, BVH, glTF, VRM, MMD from Mixamo, Rigify, UE Mannequin…) adds 2D retargeting to sprites, frame baking and twist helpers. Free for non-commercial use, no formal license.

item.title: MetaWrap (Blender character → rigged MetaHuman)
item.description: Announced Oct 29: a Blender add-on that wraps an AI character, scan or sculpt onto MetaHuman topology with the real facial rig, transfers textures and sends to Unreal in one click. Paid, $158 (Founder), Windows, Blender 5.0–5.2.

item.title: BonePilot v5.2.26 (controller navigation for animating in Blender)
item.description: Released Nov 1 under MIT: a Blender 5.2+ add-on for faster posing in Pose Mode. One-key IK/FK switch (native snap on Rigify), three pie menus filled from the rig's bone collections, fully rebindable keys and step-by-step undo.

item.title: FBones 0.9.4 beta (offline 2D skeletal editor)
item.description: Published Oct 31 under MIT: a 2D skeletal animation editor for Windows, macOS and Linux, no account or cloud. Bones, meshes, weights, constraints, dopesheet and graph editor; aims for Spine 4.3 compatibility, still partial (early beta).

item.title: Mamulengo 0.2.0 (2D skeletal animation for Godot, AI-drivable)
item.description: v0.2.0 from Oct 30, MIT: rig from a layered PSD, animate on a timeline, and an MCP server lets an AI agent move bones live. A C++ core plays characters in Godot 4.5+ and the browser (WebAssembly), and reads and writes Spine 4.3 projects.

item.title: MotionBridge (AI video → mocap on your own rig)
item.description: ComfyUI node pack released Oct 30 (Apache-2.0): a MiniMax H3 video or a text prompt (Kimodo) becomes a 77-joint skeleton, cleaned up and retargeted onto any humanoid rig, exported as BLEND/FBX/GLB. Runs locally on 8 GB VRAM; models keep their own licenses.

item.title: Golden Pose v1 (reference video → poses in Blender)
item.description: Out Oct 30: this Blender add-on finds the key poses in a reference video and poses your character with them, fingers included, in FK/IK on Auto-Rig Pro, Rigify or Mixamo rigs, locally on your PC. Paid: $10 launch price on Gumroad.

item.title: ActionForge (auto-rig and animation in the browser)
item.description: Free beta spotted Oct 29, no install or account: load an unrigged GLB/FBX character, it auto-rigs it, you layer Quaternius CC0 clips per body part, fix with IK and export with UE5, Unity, Godot or Blender presets. Proprietary code.

item.title: Chimera (text prompt → animation on your skeleton)
item.description: Released Oct 30 under MIT: from a 3D model and a prompt, LTX-2.5 generates a motion video, then Chimera fits the original rig to it (even a 35-bone creature) and exports GLB, FBX and BVH. Open-weight models via local ComfyUI, tested on 16 GB VRAM.

item.title: Stick Figure Studio (rigged 2D animation in the browser)
item.description: Created Oct 30, MIT: a 2D animation studio in a single index.html, offline and dependency-free. A stick figure acts as the hidden rig under your artwork, with IK, timeline, camera, sound and MP4 export, plus an MCP server so an AI agent can drive scenes.

item.title: LAK 2.0.0 (inspect a mocap clip in the browser)
item.description: First public release (Oct 29), Apache-2.0: open an FBX or GLB clip (mocap, keyframed or AI), step through it with joint trails, let it flag pops, jitter and rotation flips, then trim and re-export it. Everything stays on your device.

item.title: Tsukumoe (open alternative to Live2D Cubism)
item.description: Repo started Oct 30, Apache-2.0 or MIT: a 2D rigging and animation platform aiming to load Live2D (.moc3) and Inochi2D models, with a CLI, a wgpu renderer and planned lip-sync. Very early stage, not usable as an app yet.

item.title: Sekiro Animation Bridge 0.14.2 (FromSoftware animations in Blender)
item.description: Oct 29 release, GPL-3.0: imports an HKX animation from Sekiro, Dark Souls or Elden Ring with its skinned character into Blender 4.5, you edit it as an action and export HKX again. An optional add-on retargets between characters. Windows, prototype.

item.title: Maul Anim 0.7.0 (skeletal animation library in C)
item.description: Oct 29 release, MIT: a dependency-free C library for blend spaces, state machines, motion matching, IK (FABRIK, full-body), VRM spring bones and retargeting between rigs, with glTF and FBX import. 0.7.0 renames the whole API (breaking change).

item.title: SHAPES for Blender (shape key editor)
item.description: Released Oct 27: brave rabbit’s shape editor (a Maya reference) comes to Blender 4.2+ to create in pose, mirror, split, combine, drive and build facial correctives. GPL with no licence check; €20 personal, €60 commercial with RBF Nodes.

item.title: ExMR 0.1.5 (monocular video mocap)
item.description: v0.1.5 on Oct 29: ExMR turns a single video into a world-grounded SMPL-X body (hands, feet), fixes upright phone videos and adds foot contacts; BVH, FBX and Blender export since Oct 26. Research/non-commercial licence.

item.title: Tracking Toolkit 3.0 RC (VR mocap in Blender)
item.description: 3.0.0-rc.2 released Oct 26 (GPL-3.0): the add-on records OpenXR headsets and trackers straight into Blender, now through Blender 5.2+’s native XR, with NLA tracks and SMPTE timecode; Vive trackers need Blender 5.3.

item.title: VideoIntoBlenderModel (video to .glb character)
item.description: Apache-2.0 repo started Oct 16, updated Oct 25: from a video or photo it captures body, hands (30 bones) and 52 ARKit expressions, then retargets them onto a humanoid .glb, as a Blender 4.2+ extension (CUDA optional).

item.title: RGB MoCap (local video mocap, Windows)
item.description: Released Oct 26 under MIT by toyxyz: a Windows app that turns video into 3D animation with ExMR, FlowHMR or GVHMR running locally (NVIDIA GPU), fixes foot sliding and retargets to Mixamo, VRM or PMX, with FBX or VMD export.

item.title: Animatica Marionette (drag-to-pose in Blender)
item.description: New Blender 5.0+ add-on ($59, perpetual indie licence): drag a hand or foot and an offline pose model places the rest of the body, then editable motion trails, a smoothing brush and foot-slide detection, as FK keys on Rigify, ARP, CloudRig or Mixamo rigs.

item.title: Puppet (webcam VTuber, VRM and ARKit)
item.description: Released Oct 28 under MIT: a desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) that drives a VRM avatar from a plain webcam via MediaPipe (52 ARKit blendshapes, head, gaze, upper body and hands), with calibration, per-blendshape gain and VMC output.

item.title: BoneStudio (2D skeletal animation editor)
item.description: Released Oct 28 under MIT: a web and Electron 2D bone animation editor that reads and writes DragonBones 5.x projects and imports Spine 4.1/4.2, with IK, skinning, FFD mesh deformation, weight painting, curves and an MCP server for AI.

item.title: Dynamic Skinning 0.1.1 (cartoon effects on a Blender rig)
item.description: Released Oct 25–26: the Blender extension of the IEEE TVCG 2026 paper adds real-time lag, oscillation and propagation to a skinned character, driven by its bones' velocity. Prototype, Blender 4.4+, GPL (C++ code under MIT).

item.title: anymove (mocap for any creature from an AI video)
item.description: Published Oct 27 under Apache-2.0: an AI video shows the creature front and side in one frame, a DINOv2 reader finds every joint and the rig (wings, tails, eight legs) is fitted frame by frame, then exported as GLB. Needs an NVIDIA GPU and the paid fal API.

item.title: mmdance 0.1.0 (MMD dances on a Mixamo character in Blender)
item.description: Released Oct 26 under MIT: a headless Python pipeline for Blender 5.2 that retargets a MikuMikuDance VMD onto a Mixamo, Tripo, Meshy or AccuRig character, with camera, face (blinks, lip-sync) and skirt and hair physics, then renders the video.

item.title: LipScan 0.5.0 (voice → lip-sync and face curves)
item.description: Version 0.5.0 on Oct 26 (MIT, runs locally): tracks a real face on video (52 blendshapes, head, gaze) to replay it on a rig, or turns a voice alone into mouth, blink and brow curves, exported as ARKit 52 for Blender, Unity, Unreal.

item.title: OrthoRig 0.2.0 (2D rigs from Blender to PixiJS)
item.description: Version 0.2.0 on Oct 25 (MIT): build an orthographic 2D skeleton in Blender and it compiles it for PixiJS v8 with 2-bone IK, look-at, sockets, timeline events from markers, additive layers and a spritesheet baker.

item.title: spine-mcp 0.2.0 (Spine driven by an AI)
item.description: First release Oct 25 (MIT): an MCP server that lets your AI assistant build and animate Spine 4.x skeletons without the editor (bones, slots, skins, IK and physics constraints, keys), with output checked against the official runtime. Spine itself is paid.

item.title: MetaHuman ARKit Export (ARKit blendshapes from DNA)
item.description: Published Oct 24, MIT since Oct 26: an Unreal 5.7 plugin and a standalone CLI that bake the 52 ARKit blendshapes onto an exported MetaHuman, as glTF from UE or straight into the .dna files, which UE doesn't do on its own.

item.title: OSATURA 0.1.0-alpha.4 (2D vector rigging and animation in Rust)
item.description: Pre-release from Oct 25 (CLI AGPL-3.0, libraries MPL-2.0): a Moho-style 2D engine with bones, IK, skinning, deformers, a state machine, a browser studio, and GIF, video, Lottie, glTF or HTML player export. Still alpha, code largely AI-written.

item.title: CTRL_DEF 0.1.2 (auto controllers from DEF bones)
item.description: Released Oct 24 (GPL-3.0, Blender 4.2 to 5.2): select your DEF_ bones and the add-on generates colored FK controllers with shared custom shapes in one click, then binds them without dependency cycles. Same author as Auto Copy Transforms DEF (seen Oct 23).

item.title: FaceSet Creature Rigger 1.0.0
item.description: Released Oct 24 (MIT, Blender 4.2+): paint each creature limb as a Face Set, the add-on detects symmetry, lets you pick FK, IK with pole, Spline IK or wiggle, then generates the armature and smoothed weights. Brand new, 0 stars.

item.title: FellowStudio3D 0.1.0 (pixel character posing and animation)
item.description: First release Oct 24 (MIT, Windows): start from a walk or run, tweak each body part, stack motion layers, IK and physical follow, without editing keys, then export 64×64 sprites at 1x, 4x or 8x.

item.title: Auto Dangle Rig 1.9.0 (bone chains for skirts, hair, ribbons)
item.description: Paid Blender 5.2 add-on (¥300, BOOTH): builds dangle bone chains from a selection, one per skirt column, mirrors ribbons, weights by transfer or distance, then previews the jiggle on a Mixamo/VRMA clip. Announced Oct 22.

item.title: mmd-retarget 0.0.2 (VMD from one model to another, without clipping)
item.description: Created Oct 23 (GPL-3.0, Python, VMD ↔ Blender): retargets an MMD dance to another body with scaling, foot locking and arm IK, then detects frame-by-frame interpenetration with CSV/JSON reports. Very early, docs in Chinese.

item.title: C3D Reader 0.3.4 (local Mokka-style C3D viewer)
item.description: Released Oct 23 (MIT): opens your C3D mocap files locally (Apple Silicon macOS app or browser), 3D marker playback, synced analog signals, events, parameter inspector and batch CSV export, even on takes of several hundred MB.

item.title: Prima Motion Capture Volume Planner (mocap camera placement)
item.description: Published Oct 24 (AGPL-3.0 plus extra terms, name and logo not licensed): single-file web app to plan optical mocap camera placement (OptiTrack, Qualisys, Vicon), coverage, marker visibility and predicted 3D error. Geometric model only.

item.title: Batlejka (multi-camera sync → FreeMoCap → .blend)
item.description: Released Oct 21 (AGPL-3.0): drop the clips of a multi-camera mocap session (phones, no timecode), it syncs them by audio, lets you cut takes, then runs FreeMoCap to get 3D skeletons all the way to a .blend file.

item.title: three-procedural-locomotion
item.description: Released Oct 22 (MIT): procedural human locomotion for Three.js with no baked clips. Walk, run, turns, crouch and jump computed every frame (footstep planning, two-bone IK, feet on terrain), tuned against CMU mocap.

item.title: Pixel Puppettier (layer-based rigging for Aseprite)
item.description: Released Oct 22 (MIT): Aseprite extension that attaches bones to layers, with hierarchy and mouse posing; “Create frame” builds a new frame where each part stays on its own layer for pixel-art cleanup. UI in Spanish.

item.title: Auto Copy Transforms DEF 1.1.5
item.description: Released Oct 22 (GPL-3.0, Blender 4.2+ and 5.x): batch-creates Copy Transforms/Rotation/Location/Scale constraints between DEF and MCH/ORG bones, prefix, regex and L/R mapping, preview before applying and cleanup that leaves manual constraints alone.

item.title: prompt2rig (prompt → Mixamo character animation, fingers included)
item.description: Type a motion, a video model acts it out, then GVHMR + WiLoR (added Oct 20) extract body and fingers for a Mixamo character, .glb export to Blender or Unity. Apache-2.0 code, but GVHMR, SMPL-X and WiLoR are non-commercial and video goes through fal (paid).

item.title: KinetiFrame (2D animation studio for Android)
item.description: Released Oct 21: Apache-2.0 Android app mixing frame-by-frame drawing (onion skin, layers) with IK-rigged characters, finger-recorded performances, camera moves, audio and MP4 export. Offline, no account; still in development, no stable release yet.

item.title: kr-custom-rigs (Rigify extensions: configurable eye, rig tools)
item.description: GPL-3.0 Rigify extensions, Blender 5.2 compatible since Oct 21: a configurable eye rig (iris, groups, eyelids optional), a rig that moves drivers onto DEF bones, and a weight-paint mode that frees the generated rig’s bones.

item.title: Mocap Studio (video → Mixamo animation, local)
item.description: Released Oct 22: local web app (MIT) on top of Motion2MixamoRig. Upload a video of one person and a Mixamo character, it replays the motion, .glb export and an Unreal-mannequin style skeleton. Non-commercial use only (GVHMR, SMPL-X); UI in Vietnamese.

item.title: Live2D Offline Converter 0.3.0 (Live2D → Blender bones)
item.description: Experimental Blender add-on (MIT, v0.3.0 on Oct 19) that samples a Live2D clip and converts it into a native Blender armature, weights and Action that play without the plugin. 0.3 bakes masks and blend modes (Cycles). You supply the Cubism SDK yourself.

item.title: QuadMocap (AI video mocap for any rig)
item.description: Local web app (MIT, published Oct 20): give it a rigged character, it trains a DINOv2 detector on renders of your rig, then fits the skeleton to a two-view AI video. Outputs a Blender Action, .blend and FBX; tested on quadrupeds.

item.title: Stylized 2D Mouth Rig (2D mouth for Blender)
item.description: Blender 5.2 add-on launched Oct 20 at $5: one click puts a stylized 2D mouth on any head, driven in Pose Mode from a floating panel, with 28 expression and lip-sync presets, 4 styles, customizable teeth and tongue.

item.title: cascadeur MMD toolkit 1.0 (VMD in Cascadeur)
item.description: Free Cascadeur plugin (v1.0 on Oct 19, Windows): import MMD .vmd motions onto your characters, export VMD as FK or IK and clean up the generated rig. Heads-up: no license, binary only, the repo holds just the docs.

item.title: Ekza Animator (glTF/VRM character animation in the browser)
item.description: Open-source (MIT, alpha) in-browser character animator launched Oct 18: circle controls and leg IK on a GLB or VRM, Dope Sheet, a Graph Editor with Maya-style tangents, then bake back into the original file or export VRMA.

item.title: MotionBridge 0.3.0 (browser video mocap → Blender and 2D)
item.description: First public release (MIT, Oct 19): the video is analysed in the browser (MediaPipe), the motion is retargeted onto your GLB/FBX character and exported as animated GLB or BVH for Blender; a second workspace animates 2D PNG cutout puppets.

item.title: Lightweight CPU VTuber Tracker 0.1.0 (GPU-free webcam VRM mocap)
item.description: Native Windows webcam tracker in Rust (v0.1.0, Oct 19) that drives a VRM avatar on the CPU alone: 52 ARKit blendshapes, gaze, arms, torso and fingers at 30 fps. Code is Apache-2.0/MIT, but the bundled body model is under the SAM License: read it before pro use.

item.title: Riggle 0.1.1 (rig + jiggle bones, Blender-powered)
item.description: Local rigging workbench (MIT, heavy WIP) driven by Blender: fit a 22-joint humanoid skeleton to your mesh, mark what should wobble (jiggle bones), then export rigged GLB + FBX with a spring manifest. Portable Windows build on Oct 19.

item.title: PuppetForge 1.0 (2D puppets on Android)
item.description: 2D puppet studio for Android (MIT, v1.0 on Oct 20), a free alternative to Character Animator: PNG layers, pivots and bone hierarchy set by touch, live-performed animation, mic-driven lip sync, GIF or MP4 export, all on-device.

item.title: Rigger 1.2.0 (Blender auto-rig + video to animation)
item.description: Modular auto-rigger for Blender 4.2+ (GPL-3.0): 1.2.0 (Oct 18) adds local video-to-animation (body, fingers, ARKit shape keys, root motion, planted feet), AI-placed markers and a picker right in the 3D viewport.

item.title: XR Animator 0.36.0 (AI webcam mocap)
item.description: Full-body webcam mocap (MediaPipe) for VRM/MMD avatars, web or desktop: 0.36.0 (Oct 17) adds a faster “lite” body model, a GPU/CPU choice and local web app mode on Android and iOS. Free, but the repo declares no license.

item.title: L2DEditor (Live2D-style 2D puppet rigging)
item.description: Open-source (Apache-2.0) 2D puppet editor, a Cubism alternative published Oct 19: PSD import, meshing and auto-rig, keyforms, physics, .moc3 export without Live2D binaries, plus a CLI and an MCP server so AI agents can drive it.

item.title: MotionForge 1.0.1 (2D animation studio for Windows)
item.description: Flash-style vector 2D animation studio (MIT, C#/.NET 10, Windows) released Oct 19: keyframe timeline with eased tweens, layers, symbols, onion skin, GIF, PNG, sprite sheet and SVG export. 1.0.1 smooths the brush and adds an HSV wheel.

item.title: VisemeMaker 1.0.0 (VRChat visemes from A-I-U-E-O)
item.description: Unity tool (MIT) released Oct 16 that builds VRChat’s 14 visemes from the 5 vowel shapes most models already have (MMD, VRoid, Source…) and wires lip sync on the avatar descriptor, with preview and strength control.

item.title: CEB SAM 3D Body Loader (AI mocap in Blender, now free)
item.description: Since Oct 17, Carlos Barreto’s add-on is free: video mocap (GEM-X, SAM 3D Body) in Blender 4.0 to 5.2, retargeting to Auto-Rig Pro, foot-sliding fix, walk along a curve. Windows only; some underlying models are restricted to non-commercial use.

item.title: Viewport Avatar Toolset 0.4.1 (Bento animation for Second Life)
item.description: Free, open-source animation editor (LGPL-2.1, Linux and Windows) for Second Life’s Bento avatar: timeline, IK, graph editor, BVH, glTF, FBX or network mocap import, .anim and BVH export. Version 0.4 (Oct 17) resizes the whole skeleton and scales the keys.

item.title: video2live2d (video → Live2D motion)
item.description: Command-line tool (MIT, Linux and macOS) released Oct 17 that turns a face-and-shoulders video into a Live2D Cubism motion3.json for VBridger models: head, eyes, brows, mouth, breathing, auto calibration. No iPhone, no live tracking.
